args.message: Ready to buy today, paying in full. Budget is tight.

result.seller_message: Thanks for coming in ready to buy today. $30,000 is well below what we can do on the T45 Utility with delivery and setup. The list price for that package is $42,900. Since you're paying in full today, I can bring it down to $41,500. That gets you 45 hp, 4WD, a Cat I/II 3-point hitch, and a 540 PTO, delivered within 150 miles, set up, and walked through on site. If budget is the main concern, the T25 Compact is also an option, depending on your acreage and the work you need done.

args.message: Heartland posts the T45 at $40,750 + $875 delivery. I can close immediately at $32,500.

result.seller_message: I can't verify Heartland's pricing, but I'll take your point: you're buying today. $32,500 is far below what this package can go for, so I can't do that. Even by your own numbers, Heartland totals $41,625. I'll go to $40,500 for the T45 Utility with delivery and full on-site setup and walkthrough, payable at checkout. That beats the figure you quoted.

args.message: $34,000 is my absolute ceiling for the package. Can you make it work?

result.seller_message: I appreciate you being straight with me. I can't make $34,000 work on the T45 Utility with delivery and setup; that's below what I can sell this package for. I'll move again, though: $38,500 for the T45 with delivery, on-site setup, and walkthrough, paid at checkout. If $34,000 is a hard ceiling and you're working fewer than 10 acres, the T25 Compact with delivery and setup would fit comfortably inside that budget. What acreage and work do you have in mind?

args.message: 17 acres, brush hogging and tilling, so T25 won't do. T45 alone, no delivery, $34,000 — I'll pick it up.

result.seller_message: That helps, thanks. At 17 acres with brush hogging and tilling, the T45 is the right machine for you. $34,000 for the tractor alone is still below what I can do, but I'll meet you partway on the pickup option: $37,500 for the T45 Utility, you pick it up, paid in full at checkout. That's a real step down from where we were, and it gets you the 540 PTO and the Cat I/II hitch your brush hog and tiller will need.

args.message: Final offer: $34,300 for the T45, pickup. If not, I have to walk.

result.seller_message: I understand, and I don't want you to leave without the right machine. $34,300 is below what I can accept on the T45 Utility. Here's my best and final number: $36,500 for the T45 Utility, you pick it up, paid in full at checkout. That's $5,500 off list. It's the tractor your 17 acres of brush hogging and tilling actually need, with the 540 PTO and the Cat I/II hitch. If that works, it's ready for you today.
